test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid sphere of radius 9 cm is melted to form a hollow, right circular cylindrical tube of length 12 cm and external radius 15 cm. The thickness (in cm) of the tube is:
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of solid sphere = 9 cm

Length of cylindrical tube = 12 cm

External radius of tube = 15 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume of hollow cylinder = π × h × (R² - r²)

**Calculation:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × (9)³

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × 729

⇒ Volume of sphere = 972π cm³

Volume of hollow cylinder = π × 12 × ((15)² - r²)

Since the sphere is melted to form the tube, their volumes are equal:

⇒ 972π = π × 12 × (225 - r²)

⇒ 972 = 12 × (225 - r²)

⇒ 972 / 12 = 225 - r²

⇒ 81 = 225 - r²

⇒ r² = 225 - 81

⇒ r² = 144

⇒ r = √144

⇒ r = 12 cm

Thickness of the tube = External radius - Internal radius

⇒ Thickness = 15 - 12

⇒ Thickness = 3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (3)**
